summary: Iteration 2 testing complete. All 17 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend features tested successfully: promo code validation/application/removal, admin promo CRUD, QR codes on PaymentCallback and BookingDetail, return-trip upsell with reversed from/to navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: Promo code validation correctly normalizes codes to uppercase server-side
Discount calculation is server-side enforced in _calc_pricing function
Boarding validation is idempotent - second call returns already_boarded:true
QR codes use qrcode.react QRCodeSVG component with booking reference as value
Return-trip upsell correctly reverses from/to terminal IDs
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds promo codes on startup: WELCOME10 (10% off), RAYA5 (RM5 flat)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 features all working: (1) Promo codes - validate endpoint returns discount, admin CRUD works, booking with promo applies discount server-side, inactive codes rejected with 400; (2) QR codes - displayed on PaymentCallback (data-testid='booking-qr') and BookingDetail (data-testid='detail-qr') for confirmed bookings; (3) Boarding validation - returns passenger/seat info for confirmed bookings, marks boarded_at, idempotent; (4) Return-trip upsell - section on PaymentCallback with find-return-btn and book-return-btn, clicking book-return navigates to /search with reversed from/to.

backend: POST /api/promo/validate with RAYA5 returns flat RM5 discount
POST /api/bookings with WELCOME10 applies 10% discount server-side
POST /api/boarding/validate with unknown reference returns {valid:false, reason:not_found}
POST /api/boarding/validate on unconfirmed booking returns {valid:false, reason:not_confirmed}
POST /api/boarding/validate with valid confirmed reference returns passenger+seat info
POST /api/boarding/validate is idempotent (second call returns already_boarded:true)
frontend: Passengers page shows promo input with placeholder 'ENTER CODE E.G. WELCOME10'
Passengers page: applying WELCOME10 shows discount row in sidebar
Passengers page: total updates from RM 82.50 to RM 74.25 with WELCOME10
Passengers page: Remove button reverts total to original
Passengers page: invalid promo shows error 'Promo code not found'
PaymentCallback success page renders QR code (data-testid='booking-qr')
Clicking book-return navigates to /search with reversed from/to
BookingDetail renders QR code when status=confirmed (data-testid='detail-qr')
BookingDetail shows boarded_at badge when passenger has boarded
Admin page promo-codes tab shows seeded codes
Admin page: can create new promo code via form
Admin page: can toggle promo code active/off
Admin page: can delete promo code
